composition: Subject must occupy 50% to 70% of the frame, centered horizontally.
Use low-angle perspectives looking up to emphasize character status and scale, or high-angle selfie angles for candid social media framing.
Avoid flat, eye-level group lineups; use dynamic angles (Dutch tilt or three-quarter profiles) to create depth.
Maintain a clear separation between the subject and background using a shallow depth of field to blur background elements.
typographie: Keep text minimal: use a single, small, clean sans-serif brand font centered at the very top edge.
Text must be high-contrast white with a minimal footprint, occupying less than 5% of the total frame height.
If watermarks are used, place them in the bottom-left corner at low opacity to avoid distracting from the subject.
lumiere: Implement three-point lighting: soft front-left key light, subtle rim light to highlight hair/shoulders, and a colored ambient ground glow.
Avoid flat, front-on ambient lighting; ensure directional shadows exist under the chin, nose, and torso.
Incorporate high-key studio lighting (ring light/softbox) for close-ups, creating soft shadows and realistic catchlights in eyes/glasses.
etalonnage: Apply a desaturated, cool-toned color palette (blues, teals, grays) contrasted against warm skin tones.
Use high-contrast, deep blacks with vibrant, localized neon accents (magenta #FF00FF, pink #FFB6C1, or deep burgundy #800020).
For outdoor scenes, use warm golden hour tones or muted, film-like desaturated earthy tones with a soft shadow fade.
effets: Apply a soft depth-of-field blur to the background and a subtle bloom on light sources, metallic jewelry, and neon reflections.
Add a fine film grain or noise overlay (1-2% intensity) and a subtle vignette to focus attention on the center.
Incorporate realistic environmental effects like subtle smoke plumes, soft mist/fog overlays, or mild chromatic aberration on outer edges.
logo: Do not include logos on the character or background unless integrated as a realistic fabric texture on clothing.
interdits: Avoid flat, unedited game screenshots with zero directional lighting or depth.
Do not allow low-resolution, stretched, or flat ground and wall textures to be visible in the foreground.
Avoid stiff, default game-engine hand/finger poses and painted-on hair or facial hair textures.
Prevent clipping geometry, such as hair intersecting with shoulders or clothing assets floating without contact shadows.
